units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:10">Ab. I, 10</cite> <he>אהוב … ושנא את הר׳</he> love a trade, and hate office.
<cite ref="Pesachim 87b:9">Pes. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>אוי לה לר׳ וכ׳</he> woe to the (royal) authority, for it buries its holders, as there is not one prophet that did not outlive four kings.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14<sup>4</sup></cite> (play on <he>כדרבנות</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:11">Koh. XII, 11</cite>) <he>כִּדְרַ׳ … שתהא הר׳ וכ׳</he> (the words of the wise are) like those of an authority; when Jacob decreed that the leadership should be Ephraim’s (<cite ref="Genesis 48:19">Gen. XLVIII, 19</cite>), the Lord confirmed his word.
<cite ref="Sotah 13b">Sot. 13ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הנהיג עצמו בר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00250"><he>נָהַג</he></cite>; a. e.
